title: Andy’s Ancestry
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy discovers he is distantly related to Michelle Obama, which sparks mixed reactions and humorous genealogy discussions among the office staff. Meanwhile, Dwight teaches Erin the Dothraki language to help her connect with Andy's family background. Nellie prepares nervously for her driver's license test with Pam's help, and Darryl shares productivity tips. The episode also features Jim offering Darryl a potential job opportunity in Philadelphia and explores tensions and jokes around family histories and relationships.
